name: Lampenhäusl Camping
beschreibung: The campsite Lampenhäusl Camping is located in the district of Taxenbacher-Fusch in the Bundesland Tirol. The facility is situated in the Fuscher Tal, nestled in the mountain landscape of the Hohen Tauern. In the surrounding area, there are opportunities for hiking in summer and skiing and snowboarding in the nearby ski areas. The amenities include pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as sanitary facilities. The atmosphere of the site is predominantly quiet and close to nature. Guests can use the campsite as a starting point for activities in the natural and mountain world.
